Scrap from a downed Brockary.
 Beyond repair, but as a
 top-class Walker Machine and a
 Xabungle derivative it should
 be good for spare parts.

A computer core that
controls a Walker
Machine's drivetrain.
Very high-spec - few
machines use computers of
this level. The Walker
Gallia and Xabungle use
the same type.

A high-output Walker Machine
engine. The type is used in
large combat machines and
puts out enough power for
very high jumps. The
Xabungle and Walker Gallia
use the same engine.

The wreck of a badly damaged
Overman. Its muscle engine
is beyond repair. It seems
to have been powerful, but
without an overcoat it is
only good for parts.

An overcoat, apparently for
a large Overman. Its
function is unknown - the
purple shell and
signal-like parts stand
out.

A mysterious system
box. It seems to
send some signal, but
it only works under
very specific
conditions. Its true
purpose is unknown.

A mysterious mobile suit
that seems to have been
externally controlled.
Many exist, likely meant
to fight in coordinated
groups.

A book on inertial
control - steering a
machine by bending the
laws of motion. An
intro volume, mostly
basic theory.

A machine forming the
military's Assault Type
Aquarion. Three Vector
Machines exist; this
bazaar sells the Vector
Alpha. Piloting it likely
requires a special gift.

A machine forming the
military's Assault Type
Aquarion. Three Vector
Machines exist; this
bazaar sells the Vector
Omega. Piloting it likely
requires a special gift.

Part of an armament,
likely for a mobile suit
- the barrel of a huge
beam cannon. Whether
any weapon fires this
much energy is
uncertain.

A panel that receives
beamed energy. It seems
to be part of a system
that turned that energy
into a weapon.

A large energy cartridge
for beam weapons. Huge
capacity, but its size
and handling make it a
poor fit for normal beam
rifles.

A part needed to run
high-output beam weapons.
Stores a large energy
charge.

A research report on
using the Jet Scrander
as a weapon. Likely
written by Dr. Smith,
its developer.

A lizard from northern Zora
and Siberia. Mild but
tender, with juices that
flow at every bite. Just
as good smoked - roasting
adds fragrance.

Soybeans fermented with natto bacteria.
Its distinctive smell is irresistible
to those who enjoy it.
The sticky strands contain glutamic
acid, so stirring it well brings out
its flavor.

Smoked lizard from southern
Ameria. Bigger and fiercer
than the northern kind, but
its meat is high in
protein, light yet
addictive - hugely popular
and traded at high prices.

An indie magazine edited
by Gekkostate. Not in
general circulation, but
prized by those in the
know.

A music disc by Lacus
Clyne, sold before Break
the World. Hand-signed,
though whether the
autograph is real is
unknown. Long out of
print - quite the
rarity.

A one-off wheel,
oversized for trick
riding. Big wheels lost
favor since they cost
speed, but they keep
devoted fans. Handmade
craftsman pieces trade as
ultra-rare items among
them.

Worn by upper-class
ladies at public
occasions. Elegant
silverwork that adds
still more grace to a
grown woman's
accessories.

A full set: skincare
(lotion, emulsion, cleanser,
moisturizer) plus foundation,
eyebrow, mascara, eyeshadow,
eyeliner, lipstick, gloss and
blush, with tools. The vast,
profound world of makeup in
one box.

A beautiful bouquet
built on roses of every
color. Flowers mean the
same in any world, and
comfort hearts
everywhere. In space
colonies with managed
environments they are
worth far more than on
Earth.

A video disc, apparently made
in Hong Kong. The package
reads 'treasure', but it is
nearly worn out - contents
unknown.

A pennant of famous sights
all over Emaan. Pennants
were never popular souvenirs
in the old world - which now
makes them novel.

A bike with a big air-cooled V-twin.
Its sound and vibration have many fans.
Even now, with inertial control in use,
many people collect these bikes.

Armor plate from a
battle-worn Double
Spazer. Chogokin New Z is
precious but hard to work
- needs skill and gear.
